notes: Focused v1.9.0 routing regressions for #78: prompts that should reach terminal-protocols.md (tmux flicker, a Shift+Enter that does not arrive) and the visual and interaction rows (status bar, spinner, Unicode width, search, multi-select). Assertions grade the answer; whether the right reference was loaded is checked separately from the run transcript. Status (2026-10-27): recorded. Baseline and with-skill runs on Claude Code and Codex, three repetitions per case, are in evals/results/v1.9.0-claude-comparison/ and evals/results/v1.9.0-codex-comparison/ against skill tree 164c1aefd956.

evals.name: tmux-flicker
evals.prompt: My full-screen TUI flickers when it runs inside tmux. It redraws the whole screen on every update. What should I do?
assertions: Recommends wrapping each frame in synchronized output (mode 2026) so the terminal paints it at once, and detecting support with DECRQM
Notes tmux supports synchronized output from version 3.7 and that without it each frame should be written in one write, send only changed cells, and hide the cursor while drawing
Says to always send the end sequence, error paths included
Does not suggest simply lowering the frame rate as the only fix

evals.name: shift-enter-missing
evals.prompt: Shift+Enter inserts nothing different from Enter in my TUI's input field, especially inside tmux. How do I get a newline?
assertions: Explains that Shift+Enter is distinguishable from Enter only with the kitty keyboard protocol or modifyOtherKeys, which the terminal must support
Notes tmux needs the extended-keys option, which is off by default
Falls back to Alt+Enter or Ctrl+J for inserting a newline and tells users the key
Treats the extra keys as accelerators and keeps a binding that works in the legacy encoding

evals.name: status-and-unicode-routing
evals.prompt: My status bar shows a spinner and my table has emoji and CJK text that misalign. Where should I look and what are the rules?
assertions: Treats the spinner and status bar as the progress and status-line guidance (delayed spinner, static line in plain mode, messages that lead with a symbol or label)
Explains that emoji and CJK widths differ and recommends grapheme-aware width measurement
Mentions ambiguous-width characters and narrow-class alternatives or an ASCII fallback

evals.name: search-and-multiselect-routing
evals.prompt: In my list view, `/` should do what, and how should multi-select work if the list also has a type-to-filter box?
assertions: Says `/` filters lists and searches documents and logs
Says Space toggles the mark when no text field owns input, and Tab marks in a type-to-filter picker
Shows the match count and clears the filter with Esc
